title: Philips Hue Bridge Pro Protection Mechanism Failure Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-122044)
description: CVE-2026-122044 is an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Philips Hue Bridge Pro HTTP service, which listens on TCP port 443 by default. This flaw allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication without needing credentials due to a failure in applying a protection mechanism. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.8 and impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
